geography.sql: SELECT w.w_country,w.w_state,COUNT(w.w_warehouse_sk) warehouse_count,COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_city) city_count,MIN(w.w_warehouse_sk) min_warehouse_sk,MAX(w.w_warehouse_sk) max_warehouse_sk,MIN(g.global_key) global_min_warehouse_sk FROM warehouse w CROSS JOIN (SELECT MIN(w_warehouse_sk) global_key FROM warehouse) g GROUP BY w.w_country,w.w_state ORDER BY w.w_country,w.w_state

inventory_a02.sql: SELECT d.d_date snapshot_date,COUNT(*) sku_record_count,COUNT(CASE WHEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand>0 THEN 1 END) nonzero_sku_count,COUNT(CASE WHEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand=0 THEN 1 END) zero_sku_count,SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) total_on_hand FROM date_dim d JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk=d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk=inv.inv_item_sk WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-01-29' AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk=2 AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand>=0 GROUP BY d.d_date ORDER BY d.d_date

inventory_a05.sql: SELECT d.d_date snapshot_date,COUNT(*) sku_record_count,COUNT(CASE WHEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand>0 THEN 1 END) nonzero_sku_count,COUNT(CASE WHEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand=0 THEN 1 END) zero_sku_count,SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) total_on_hand FROM date_dim d JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk=d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk=inv.inv_item_sk WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN '1998-01-15' AND '1998-01-29' AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk=4 AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand>=500 AND i.i_category='Books' GROUP BY d.d_date ORDER BY d.d_date
